learning_outcomes.text: Students will have learned the measurement principles and application-oriented techniques that can respond to measurement needs encountered in machine manufacturing and use.
Students will be able to select the appropriate device, system, or method for correct solutions in encountered measurement technique problems.
Students will learn how to use the relevant measuring device or system.
Students will learn the working principle of the relevant measuring device or system.
Students will recognize and be able to apply methods for evaluating obtained measurement data.
Students will internalize the concepts of calibration, accuracy, uncertainty, precision, repeatability, and traceability related to metrology.
Students will be familiar with metrology-related standards, knowing where to access them and how to use them.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Measurement Techniques and Definitions
Turkish Standards Used in Measurement Techniques
Introduction to Other Foreign Standards, Norms, and Rules
Measuring Devices Used in Machine Manufacturing
Measuring Devices Used in Machine Manufacturing
Types of Errors and Analysis, Calibration
Tolerances, Fits, Fit Tolerances, ISO Fit System
Flow Measurement, Level Measurement, Measurement of Thermophysical Properties
Force, Moment, and Shaft Power Measurement
Electrical Measurements in Mechanical Engineering, Sensors and Basic Physical Characteristics of Sensors, Air Pollution Sampling and Measurement
